verses.kjv: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
verses.modern: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all His kingdom and also put it in writing:

verses.kjv: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, The LORD God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
verses.modern: "Thus says Cyrus king of Persia: The LORD, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth. He has charged me to build Him a house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

verses.kjv: Who is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD God of Israel, (he is the God,) which is in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Whoever is among you of all his people, may his God be with Him, and let Him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and rebuild the house of the LORD, the God of Israel — He is the God Who is in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Let each survivor, in whatever place He sojourns, be assisted by the men of His place with silver and gold, with goods and with beasts, besides freewill offerings for the house of God that is in Jerusalem."

verses.kjv: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Then rose up the heads of the fathers' houses of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests and the Levites, everyone whose spirit God had stirred to go up to rebuild the house of the LORD that is in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all that was willingly offered.
verses.modern: All who were around them aided them with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, with beasts, and with costly wares, besides all that was freely offered.

verses.kjv: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;
verses.modern: Cyrus the king also brought out the vessels of the house of the LORD that Nebuchadnezzar had carried away from Jerusalem and placed in the house of His gods.

verses.kjv: Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.
verses.modern: Cyrus king of Persia brought these out in the charge of Mithredath the treasurer, who counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

verses.kjv: And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,
verses.modern: This was the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, one thousand chargers of silver, twenty-nine knives,

verses.kjv: Thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.
verses.modern: Thirty bowls of gold, four hundred ten bowls of silver of a second kind, and one thousand other vessels;

verses.kjv: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.
verses.modern: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred. All these Sheshbazzar brought up, when the exiles were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.

chapters.summary: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, the LORD stirred his spirit to decree that the Jews could return to Jerusalem and rebuild the temple. Cyrus also returned the gold and silver vessels Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the house of God.

verses.kjv: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;
verses.modern: Now these were the people of the province who came up out of the captivity of those exiles whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried captive to Babylon. They returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his own town.

verses.modern: All the temple servants and the sons of Solomon's servants were three hundred ninety-two.

verses.kjv: And these were they which went up from Telmelah, Telharsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:
verses.modern: The following were those who came up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer, though they could not prove their fathers' houses or their descent, whether they belonged to Israel:

verses.kjv: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.modern: The sons of Delaiah, the sons of Tobiah, and the sons of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two.

verses.kjv: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:
verses.modern: Also, of the sons of the priests: the sons of Hobaiah, the sons of Hakkoz, and the sons of Barzillai — who had taken a wife from the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name.

verses.kjv: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
verses.modern: These searched for their entries in the genealogical records. But they were not found there, and so they were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.

verses.kjv: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.
verses.modern: The governor told them that they were not to partake of the most holy food until there should be a priest to consult Urim and Thummim.

verses.kjv: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
verses.modern: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

verses.kjv: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.
verses.modern: Besides their male and female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven. They had two hundred male and female singers.

verses.kjv: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;
verses.modern: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six, their mules were two hundred forty-five,

verses.kjv: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
verses.modern: Their camels were four hundred thirty-five. Their donkeys were six thousand seven hundred twenty.

verses.kjv: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the LORD which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:
verses.modern: Some of the heads of fathers' houses, when they came to the house of the LORD that is in Jerusalem, made freewill offerings for the house of God, to erect it on its site.

verses.kjv: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests' garments.
verses.modern: According to their ability they gave to the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests' garments.

verses.kjv: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
verses.modern: The priests, the Levites. Some of the people lived in Jerusalem and its vicinity, and the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants lived in their towns. All Israel in their towns.

chapters.summary: The chapter lists by family the exiles who returned to Jerusalem and Judah with Zerubbabel, totaling 42,360 besides servants. The leaders gave freewill offerings of gold and silver for the rebuilding of the temple.

verses.kjv: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: When the seventh month came, and the people of Israel were in the towns, the people gathered as one man to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.
verses.modern: Then Jeshua the son of Jozadak, with his fellow priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel with his kinsmen, arose and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings on it, as it is written in the Law of Moses the man of God.

verses.kjv: And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD, even burnt offerings morning and evening.
verses.modern: They set the altar in its place, for fear was on them because of the peoples of the lands. They offered burnt offerings on it to the LORD, burnt offerings morning and evening.

verses.kjv: They kept also the feast of tabernacles, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as the duty of every day required;
verses.modern: They kept the Feast of Booths, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number according to the rule, as each day required,

verses.kjv: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD.
verses.modern: After that the regular burnt offerings, the offerings at the new moon and at all the appointed feasts of the LORD, and the offerings of everyone who made a freewill offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD. But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not yet laid.
verses.modern: From the first day of the seventh month they began to offer burnt offerings to the LORD. But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not yet laid.

verses.kjv: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.
verses.modern: So they gave money to the masons and the carpenters, and food, drink, and oil to the Sidonians and the Tyrians to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea, to Joppa, according to the grant that they had from Cyrus king of Persia.

verses.kjv: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: Now in the second year after their coming to the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Jeshua the son of Jozadak made a beginning, together with the rest of their brothers, the priests and the Levites and all who had come to Jerusalem from the captivity. They appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to supervise the work of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.
verses.modern: Jeshua with His sons and His brothers, and Kadmiel and His sons, the sons of Judah, together supervised the workmen in the house of God, along with the sons of Henadad and the Levites, their sons and brothers.

verses.kjv: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD, after the ordinance of David king of Israel.
verses.modern: When the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, the priests in their vestments came forward with trumpets, and the Levites, the sons of Asaph, with cymbals, to praise the LORD, according to the directions of David king of Israel.

verses.kjv: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD; because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.
verses.modern: They sang responsively, praising and giving thanks to the LORD, "For He is good, for His mercy endures forever toward Israel." And all the people shouted with a great shout when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.

verses.kjv: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:
verses.modern: But many of the priests and Levites and heads of fathers' houses, old men who had seen the first house, wept with a loud voice when they saw the foundation of this house being laid, though many shouted aloud for joy,

verses.kjv: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
verses.modern: So that the people could not distinguish the sound of the joyful shout from the sound of the people's weeping, for the people shouted with a great shout, and the sound was heard far away.

chapters.summary: The returned exiles built the altar and offered burnt offerings in the seventh month, then laid the foundation of the temple in the second year. The old men who remembered Solomon’s temple wept, while the younger generation shouted for joy.

verses.kjv: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the LORD God of Israel;
verses.modern: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the returned exiles were building a temple to the LORD, the God of Israel,

verses.kjv: Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esarhaddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.
verses.modern: They approached Zerubbabel and the heads of fathers' houses and said to them, "Let us build with you, for we worship your God as you do. We have been sacrificing to Him ever since the days of Esarhaddon king of Assyria who brought us here."

verses.kjv: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.
verses.modern: But Zerubbabel, Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of fathers' houses in Israel said to them, "You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we alone will build to the LORD, the God of Israel, as King Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us."

verses.kjv: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,
verses.modern: Then the people of the land discouraged the people of Judah and made them afraid to build

verses.kjv: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.modern: They hired counsellors against them to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

verses.kjv: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.modern: In the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.
verses.modern: In the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam and Mithredath and Tabeel and the rest of their associates wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia. The letter was written in Aramaic and translated.

verses.kjv: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:
verses.modern: Rehum the commander and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king as follows:

verses.kjv: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, and the Elamites,
verses.modern: Rehum the commander, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their associates — the judges, the governors, the officials, the Persians, the men of Erech, the Babylonians, the men of Susa, that is, the Elamites,

verses.kjv: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnapper brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest that are on this side the river, and at such a time.
verses.modern: The rest of the nations whom the great and noble Osnappar deported and settled in the cities of Samaria and in the rest of the province Beyond the River —

verses.kjv: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.
verses.modern: This is a copy of the letter that they sent to him, to Artaxerxes the king: "Your servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.

verses.kjv: Be it known unto the king, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls thereof, and joined the foundations.
verses.modern: Be it known to the king that the Jews who came up from you to us have gone to Jerusalem. They are rebuilding that rebellious and wicked city. They are finishing the walls and repairing the foundations.

verses.kjv: Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings.
verses.modern: Now be it known to the king that if this city is rebuilt and the walls finished, they will not pay tribute, custom, or toll, and the royal revenue will be harmed.

verses.kjv: Now because we have maintenance from the king's palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king's dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;
verses.modern: Now because we eat the salt of the palace and it is not fitting for us to witness the king's dishonor, therefore we send and inform the king,

verses.kjv: That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.
verses.modern: In order that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers. So shall you find in the book of the records and know that this city is a rebellious city, hurtful to kings and provinces, and that they have stirred up sedition within it from of old. That was why this city was laid waste.

verses.kjv: We certify the king that, if this city be builded again, and the walls thereof set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river.
verses.modern: We make known to the king that if this city is rebuilt and its walls finished, you will then have no possession in the province Beyond the River."

verses.kjv: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.
verses.modern: Then the king sent an answer to Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe and the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and to the rest beyond the river: Peace, and at such a time.

verses.kjv: The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me.
verses.modern: The letter that you sent to us has been plainly read before me.

verses.kjv: And I commanded, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.
verses.modern: I made a decree, and search has been made. It has been found that this city from of old has risen against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made in it.

verses.kjv: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.
verses.modern: Mighty kings have been over Jerusalem, who ruled over the whole province Beyond the River, to whom tribute, custom, and toll were paid.

verses.kjv: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.
verses.modern: Therefore make a decree that these men be made to cease, and that this city be not rebuilt, until a decree is made by me.

verses.kjv: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
verses.modern: Be careful not to be slack in this matter. Why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?"

verses.kjv: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes' letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.
verses.modern: Then, when the copy of King Artaxerxes' letter was read before Rehum and Shimshai the scribe and their associates, they went in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews and forcibly made them stop.

verses.kjv: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.modern: Then the work on the house of God that is in Jerusalem stopped. It ceased until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

chapters.summary: The adversaries of Judah offered to help build the temple but were refused; they then hired counselors to frustrate the work and wrote accusations to the Persian kings. The building was halted until the second year of Darius.

verses.kjv: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, even unto them.
verses.modern: Now the prophets, Haggai and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem, in the name of the God of Israel who was over them.

verses.kjv: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of God helping them.
verses.modern: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Jeshua the son of Jozadak arose and began to rebuild the house of God that is in Jerusalem, and the prophets of God were with them, supporting them.

verses.kjv: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shetharboznai, and their companions, and said thus unto them, Who hath commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?
verses.modern: At the same time Tattenai the governor of the province Beyond the River and Shethar-bozenai and their associates came to them and spoke to them thus: "Who gave you a decree to build this house and to finish this structure?"

verses.kjv: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?
verses.modern: They also asked them this: "What are the names of the men who are building this building?"

verses.kjv: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter.
verses.modern: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews. They did not stop them until the report should reach Darius and then an answer be returned by letter concerning it.

verses.kjv: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shetharboznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, which were on this side the river, sent unto Darius the king:
verses.modern: This is a copy of the letter that Tatnai the governor on this side the river, and Shetharboznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, which were on this side the river, sent to Darius the king.

verses.kjv: They sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus; Unto Darius the king, all peace.
verses.modern: They sent him a report, in which was written as follows: "To Darius the king, all peace.

verses.kjv: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goeth fast on, and prospereth in their hands.
verses.modern: Be it known to the king that we went to the province of Judah, to the house of the great God. It is being built with huge stones, and timber is laid in the walls. This work goes on diligently and prospers in their hands.

verses.kjv: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?
verses.modern: Then we asked those elders and spoke to them thus: 'Who gave you a decree to build this house and to finish this structure?'

verses.kjv: We asked their names also, to certify thee, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.
verses.modern: We also asked them their names, for your information, that we might write down the names of their leaders.

verses.kjv: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was builded these many years ago, which a great king of Israel builded and set up.
verses.modern: This was their reply to us: 'We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth. We are rebuilding the house that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished.

verses.kjv: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.
verses.modern: But because our fathers had angered the God of heaven, He gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house and carried away the people to Babylon.

verses.kjv: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.
verses.modern: However, in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus the king made a decree that this house of God should be rebuilt.

verses.kjv: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered unto one, whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;
verses.modern: The gold and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple that was in Jerusalem and brought into the temple of Babylon, these Cyrus the king took out of the temple of Babylon. They were delivered to one whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be builded in his place.
verses.modern: He said to him, "Take these vessels, go and put them in the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be rebuilt on its site."

verses.kjv: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now hath it been in building, and yet it is not finished.
verses.modern: Then this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of the house of God that is in Jerusalem, and from that time until now it has been in building. It is not yet finished.'

verses.kjv: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let there be search made in the king's treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it be so, that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.
verses.modern: Therefore, if it seems good to the king, let search be made in the royal archives there in Babylon, to see whether a decree was issued by Cyrus the king for the rebuilding of this house of God in Jerusalem. And let the king send us his pleasure in this matter."

chapters.summary: Haggai and Zechariah prophesied to the Jews, and Zerubbabel and Jeshua resumed building the temple. Tattenai the governor questioned their authority and wrote to Darius asking whether Cyrus had indeed issued a decree.

verses.kjv: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.
verses.modern: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in Babylon, in the house of the archives where documents were stored.

verses.kjv: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:
verses.modern: In Ecbatana, the citadel that is in the province of Media, a scroll was found on which this was written: "A record.

verses.kjv: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, Let the house be builded, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;
verses.modern: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king issued a decree: Concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, let the house be rebuilt, the place where sacrifices were offered, and let its foundations be retained. Its height shall be sixty cubits and its breadth sixty cubits,

verses.kjv: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be given out of the king's house:
verses.modern: With three layers of great stones and one layer of timber. Let the cost be paid from the royal treasury.

verses.kjv: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place, and place them in the house of God.
verses.modern: Also let the gold and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be restored and brought back to the temple in Jerusalem, each to its place. You shall put them in the house of God."

verses.kjv: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shetharboznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be ye far from thence:
verses.modern: "Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shetharboznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, keep away from there.

verses.kjv: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place.
verses.modern: Let the work on this house of God alone. Let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews rebuild this house of God on its site.

verses.kjv: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king's goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expenses be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.
verses.modern: Moreover, I make a decree regarding what you shall do for these elders of the Jews for the rebuilding of this house of God. The cost is to be paid to these men in full and without delay from the royal revenue, the tribute of the province Beyond the River.

verses.kjv: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:
verses.modern: Whatever is needed — bulls, rams, or sheep for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, or oil, as the priests at Jerusalem require — let that be given to them day by day without fail,

verses.kjv: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.
verses.modern: That they may offer pleasing sacrifices to the God of heaven and pray for the life of the king and his sons.

verses.kjv: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.
verses.modern: Also I make a decree: if anyone alters this edict, a beam shall be pulled out of his house. Being set up, let him be hanged on it. His house shall be made a dunghill.

verses.kjv: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.
verses.modern: May the God Who has caused His name to dwell there overthrow any king or people who shall put out a hand to alter this, or to destroy this house of God that is in Jerusalem. I Darius make a decree; let it be done with all diligence."

verses.kjv: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shetharboznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.
verses.modern: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shetharboznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.

verses.kjv: And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
verses.modern: The elders of the Jews built and prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. They finished their building by decree of the God of Israel and by decree of Cyrus and Darius and Artaxerxes king of Persia;

verses.kjv: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
verses.modern: This house was finished on the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,
verses.modern: The people of Israel, the priests and the Levites, and the rest of the returned exiles, celebrated the dedication of this house of God with joy.

verses.kjv: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
verses.modern: They offered at the dedication of this house of God one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and as a sin offering for all Israel twelve male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.
verses.modern: They set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their divisions, for the service of God at Jerusalem, as it is written in the Book of Moses.

verses.kjv: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.modern: On the fourteenth day of the first month, the returned exiles kept the Passover.

verses.kjv: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.
verses.modern: For the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together; all of them were clean. So they slaughtered the Passover lamb for all the returned exiles, for their fellow priests, and for themselves.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, did eat,
verses.modern: It was eaten by the people of Israel who had returned from exile, and also by everyone who had joined them and separated Himself from the uncleanness of the peoples of the land to worship the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
verses.modern: They kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread seven days with joy, for the LORD had made them joyful and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, so that he aided them in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.

chapters.summary: Darius found Cyrus’s decree in the archives and ordered the temple work to continue with full support from the royal treasury. The temple was completed and dedicated with joy, and the returned exiles kept the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread.

verses.kjv: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.modern: Now after this, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

verses.kjv: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
verses.modern: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

verses.kjv: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
verses.modern: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

verses.kjv: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
verses.modern: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

verses.kjv: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:
verses.modern: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest —

verses.kjv: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.
verses.modern: This Ezra went up from Babylon, and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given. The king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD His God upon Him.

verses.kjv: And there went up some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.modern: There went up also some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, to Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

verses.kjv: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.
verses.modern: Ezra came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

verses.kjv: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
verses.modern: For on the first day of the first month he began to go up from Babylonia, and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, for the good hand of his God was on Him.

verses.kjv: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
verses.modern: For Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, and to do it and to teach His statutes and rules in Israel.

verses.kjv: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe, even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD, and of his statutes to Israel:
verses.modern: This is a copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, a man learned in matters of the commandments of the LORD and His statutes for Israel:

verses.kjv: Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect peace, and at such a time.
verses.modern: Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven: perfect peace, and at such a time.

verses.kjv: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with thee.
verses.modern: I make a decree that anyone of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom, who freely offers to go to Jerusalem, may go with you.

verses.kjv: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand;
verses.modern: For you are sent by the king and his seven counselors to make inquiries about Judah and Jerusalem according to the Law of your God, which is in your hand,

verses.kjv: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,
verses.modern: Also to carry the silver and gold that the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,

verses.kjv: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem:
verses.modern: With all the silver and gold that you shall find in the whole province of Babylon, and with the freewill offering of the people and the priests, offered willingly for the house of their God that is in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: With this money, then, you shall with all diligence buy bulls, rams, and lambs, with their grain offerings and their drink offerings, and you shall offer them on the altar of the house of your God that is in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.
verses.modern: Whatever seems good to you and your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and gold, you may do, according to the will of your God.

verses.kjv: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.
verses.modern: The vessels that have been given you for the service of the house of your God, You shall deliver before the God of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king's treasure house.
verses.modern: Whatever else is required for the house of your God, which it falls to you to provide, you may provide it out of the king's treasury.

verses.kjv: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,
verses.modern: I, Artaxerxes the king, make a decree to all the treasurers in the province Beyond the River: Whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven, requires of you, let it be done with all diligence,

verses.kjv: Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.
verses.modern: Up to one hundred talents of silver, one hundred cors of wheat, one hundred baths of wine, one hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
verses.modern: Whatever is decreed by the God of heaven, let it be done in full for the house of the God of heaven, lest His wrath be against the realm of the king and his sons.

verses.kjv: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.
verses.modern: We also notify you that it shall not be lawful to impose tribute, custom, or toll on anyone of the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, the temple servants, or other servants of this house of God.

verses.kjv: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that is in thine hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye them that know them not.
verses.modern: You, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges who may judge all the people in the province Beyond the River, all such as know the laws of your God. And those who do not know them, you shall teach.

verses.kjv: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether it be unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.
verses.modern: Whoever will not obey the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be strictly executed on him, whether death or banishment or confiscation of his goods or imprisonment."

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD God of our fathers, which hath put such a thing as this in the king's heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem:
verses.modern: Blessed be the LORD, the God of our fathers, who put such a thing as this into the heart of the king, to beautify the house of the LORD that is in Jerusalem,

verses.kjv: And hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king's mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of the LORD my God was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.
verses.modern: Who extended to me His mercy before the king and his counselors, and before all the king's mighty officers. I took courage, for the hand of the LORD my God was on me. I gathered leading men from Israel to go up with me.

chapters.summary: Ezra, a priest and scribe skilled in the law of Moses, went up from Babylon to Jerusalem in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes. The king gave him a letter authorizing him to teach the law and appoint judges, with silver and gold for the house of God.

verses.kjv: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.modern: These are the heads of their fathers' houses, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylonia, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king:

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel. Of the sons of David, Hattush.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Shecaniah, who was of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah, with whom were registered one hundred fifty men.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Pahathmoab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Pahath-moab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred men.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Shechaniah, the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred men.

verses.kjv: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty men.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy men.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him eighty men.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred eighteen men.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah, and with him one hundred sixty men.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty-eight men.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him one hundred ten men.

verses.kjv: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Adonikam, those who came last, their names being Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah, and with them sixty men.

verses.kjv: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zaccur, and with them seventy men.

verses.kjv: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
verses.modern: I gathered them to the river that runs to Ahava, and there we camped three days. As I reviewed the people and the priests, I found there none of the sons of Levi.

verses.kjv: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.
verses.modern: Then I sent for Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, who were leading men, and for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were men of insight.

verses.kjv: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.
verses.modern: I sent them to Iddo, the leading man at the place Casiphia, telling them what to say to Iddo and his brothers and the temple servants at the place Casiphia, namely, to send us ministers for the house of our God.

verses.kjv: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;
verses.modern: By the good hand of our God on us, they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli the son of Levi, son of Israel, namely Sherebiah with His sons and kinsmen, eighteen;

verses.kjv: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;
verses.modern: Also Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, with his kinsmen and their sons, twenty;

verses.kjv: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.
verses.modern: Besides two hundred twenty of the temple servants, whom David and his officials had set apart to attend the Levites. These were all mentioned by name.

verses.kjv: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
verses.modern: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from Him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.

verses.kjv: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
verses.modern: For I was ashamed to ask the king for a band of soldiers and horsemen to protect us against the enemy on our way, since we had told the king, "The hand of our God is for good on all who seek Him, and the power of His wrath is against all who forsake Him."

verses.kjv: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
verses.modern: So we fasted and implored our God for this. He listened to our entreaty.

verses.kjv: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,
verses.modern: Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests: Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their kinsmen with them.

verses.kjv: And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel there present, had offered:
verses.modern: I weighed out to them the silver and the gold and the vessels, the offering for the house of our God that the king and his counselors and his lords and all Israel there present had offered.

verses.kjv: I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, and of gold an hundred talents;
verses.modern: I weighed out into their hands six hundred fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels worth a hundred talents, and a hundred talents of gold,

verses.kjv: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
verses.modern: Twenty bowls of gold worth a thousand darics, and two vessels of fine bright bronze as precious as gold.

verses.kjv: And I said unto them, Ye are holy unto the LORD; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering unto the LORD God of your fathers.
verses.modern: I said to them, "You are holy to the LORD, and the vessels are holy, and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering to the LORD, the God of Your fathers.

verses.kjv: Watch ye, and keep them, until ye weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: Guard them and keep them until You weigh them before the chief priests and the Levites and the heads of fathers' houses in Israel at Jerusalem, within the chambers of the house of the LORD."

verses.kjv: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.
verses.modern: So the priests and the Levites took over the weight of the silver and the gold and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem, to the house of our God.

verses.kjv: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.
verses.modern: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us. He delivered us from the hand of the enemy and from ambushes on the way.

verses.kjv: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.
verses.modern: We came to Jerusalem and stayed there three days.

verses.kjv: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;
verses.modern: On the fourth day, within the house of our God, the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed into the hands of Meremoth the priest, son of Uriah, and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas, and with them were the Levites, Jozabad the son of Jeshua and Noadiah the son of Binnui.

verses.kjv: By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.
verses.modern: The whole was counted and weighed, and the weight of everything was recorded.

verses.kjv: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the LORD.
verses.modern: At that time those who had come from captivity, the returned exiles, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel, twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and as a sin offering twelve male goats. All this was a burnt offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they delivered the king's commissions unto the king's lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.
verses.modern: They also delivered the king's commissions to the king's satraps and to the governors of the province Beyond the River. They aided the people and the house of God.

chapters.summary: Ezra listed the heads of families who returned with him from Babylon, including Levites he specially recruited. He proclaimed a fast for safe travel, refusing a military escort, and the company arrived safely in Jerusalem with the treasures intact.

verses.kjv: Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands, doing according to their abominations, even of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
verses.modern: After these things had been done, the officials approached me and said, "The people of Israel and the priests and the Levites have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands, doing according to their abominations, those of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

verses.kjv: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of those lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been chief in this trespass.
verses.modern: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of those lands. And the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this trespass."

verses.kjv: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonied.
verses.modern: As soon as I heard this, I tore my garment and my cloak and pulled hair from my head and beard and sat appalled.

verses.kjv: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonied until the evening sacrifice.
verses.modern: Then all who trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away, gathered to me while I sat astonished until the evening sacrifice.

verses.kjv: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; and having rent my garment and my mantle, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands unto the LORD my God,
verses.modern: At the evening sacrifice I rose from my fasting, with my garment and my cloak torn, and fell on my knees and spread out my hands to the LORD my God,

verses.kjv: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.
verses.modern: Saying: "O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift my face to You, my God, for our iniquities have risen higher than our heads, and our guilt has mounted up to the heavens.

verses.kjv: Since the days of our fathers have we been in a great trespass unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.
verses.modern: From the days of our fathers to this day we have been in great guilt. And for our iniquities we, our kings, and our priests have been given into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plundering, and to utter shame, as it is today.

verses.kjv: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.
verses.modern: But now for a little space grace has been shown from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in His holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes and give us a little reviving in our bondage.

verses.kjv: For we were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: For we are slaves. Yet our God has not forsaken us in our slavery, but has extended to us His mercy before the kings of Persia, to grant us some reviving to set up the house of our God, to repair its ruins, and to give us protection in Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,
verses.modern: Now, O our God, what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken Your commandments,

verses.kjv: Which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.
verses.modern: Which You commanded by Your servants the prophets, saying, 'The land that You are entering, to take possession of it, is a land impure with the impurity of the peoples of the lands, with their abominations that have filled it from end to end with their uncleanness.

verses.kjv: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.
verses.modern: Therefore do not give Your daughters to their sons, neither take their daughters for Your sons, and never seek their peace or prosperity, that You may be strong and eat the good of the land and leave it for an inheritance to Your children forever.'

verses.kjv: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great trespass, seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and hast given us such deliverance as this;
verses.modern: After all that has come upon us for our evil deeds and for our great guilt, seeing that You, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserved and have given us such a remnant as this,

verses.kjv: Should we again break thy commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations? wouldest not thou be angry with us till thou hadst consumed us, so that there should be no remnant nor escaping?
verses.modern: Shall we break Your commandments again and intermarry with the peoples who practice these abominations? Would You not be angry with us until You consumed us, so that there should be no remnant, nor any to escape?

verses.kjv: O LORD God of Israel, thou art righteous: for we remain yet escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before thee in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before thee because of this.
verses.modern: O LORD, the God of Israel, You are just, for we are left a remnant that has escaped, as it is today. We are before You in our guilt, for none can stand before You because of this."

chapters.summary: Ezra learned that the people, priests, and Levites had intermarried with the surrounding pagan nations. He tore his garments and fell on his face before God, praying a confession of guilt and shame for the nation’s unfaithfulness.

verses.kjv: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.
verses.modern: While Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, a very great assembly of men, women, and children gathered to Him out of Israel, for the people wept bitterly.

verses.kjv: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.
verses.modern: Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, of the sons of Elam, addressed Ezra: "We have broken faith with our God and have married foreign women from the peoples of the land, but even now there is hope for Israel in spite of this.

verses.kjv: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.
verses.modern: Therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all these wives and their children, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God, and let it be done according to the Law.

verses.kjv: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.
verses.modern: Arise, for it is your task. We are with you; be strong and do it."

verses.kjv: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.
verses.modern: Then Ezra arose and made the leading priests and Levites and all Israel take an oath that they would do as had been said. So they took the oath.

verses.kjv: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.
verses.modern: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib. And when He came there, He did eat no bread, nor drink water, for He mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.

verses.kjv: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;
verses.modern: A proclamation was made throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the returned exiles that they should assemble at Jerusalem,

verses.kjv: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.
verses.modern: That whoever did not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.

verses.kjv: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.
verses.modern: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled at Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month. And all the people sat in the open square before the house of God, trembling because of this matter and because of the heavy rain.

verses.kjv: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the guilt of Israel.
verses.modern: Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, "You have broken faith and married foreign women, and so increased the guilt of Israel.

verses.kjv: Now therefore make confession unto the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.
verses.modern: Now then make confession to the LORD, the God of Your fathers and do His will. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign wives."

verses.kjv: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.
verses.modern: Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice, "It is so; we must do as You have said.

verses.kjv: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.
verses.modern: But the people are many. It is a time of heavy rain; we cannot stand in the open. Nor is this a task for one day or for two, for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.

verses.kjv: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.
verses.modern: Let our officials stand for the whole assembly. Let all in our cities who have taken foreign wives come at appointed times, and with them the elders and judges of every city, until the fierce wrath of our God over this matter is turned away from us."

verses.kjv: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
verses.modern: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

verses.kjv: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
verses.modern: Then the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

verses.kjv: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.
verses.modern: By the first day of the first month they had come to the end of all the men who had married foreign women.

verses.kjv: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.
verses.modern: Now there were found some of the sons of the priests who had married foreign women: of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

verses.kjv: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.
verses.modern: They pledged themselves to put away their wives. Their guilt offering was a ram of the flock for their guilt.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

verses.kjv: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
verses.modern: Of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (that is, Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

verses.kjv: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.
verses.modern: Of the singers: Eliashib. Of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

verses.kjv: Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.
verses.modern: Of Israel: of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Elijah.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

verses.kjv: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Pahathmoab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Pahath-moab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
verses.modern: Of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

verses.kjv: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
verses.modern: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,
verses.modern: Of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,

verses.kjv: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,
verses.modern: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,

verses.kjv: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
verses.modern: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

verses.kjv: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,
verses.modern: Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu,

verses.kjv: And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,
verses.modern: Bani, Binnui, Shimei,

verses.kjv: And Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,
verses.modern: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,

verses.kjv: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
verses.modern: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

verses.kjv: Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,
verses.modern: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,

verses.kjv: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
verses.modern: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benaiah.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah.

verses.kjv: All these had taken strange wives: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.
verses.modern: All these had married foreign women. Some of the women had even borne them children.

chapters.summary: The people gathered to Ezra weeping, and Shecaniah proposed a covenant to put away the foreign wives. Ezra made the leaders swear to it; a great assembly gathered in Jerusalem, and within three months the investigation was completed and the guilty were listed.
